correctness.rationale: Let L=q^(n-1)(q^n-1)/(q-1). Rank<=2 and trace=2 are necessary. For rank 1, common-image and common-row line families each have q^(n-1) members, meeting in P=Q only in odd characteristic, yielding 2q^(n-1)-1 versus 2q^(n-1). For rank 2, image W=im C and its restriction M uniquely reduce each decomposition to a rank-one projector T of W with functional phi satisfying phi(u)=phi(Mu)=1. Nonscalar invariant lines give q choices only when their eigenvalue is one; non-invariant lines give one, yielding q+1-e(M)+q e1(M), with scalar cases separate. The common line/row union counts give the global rank spectrum; traces and field-2 boundaries are correctly normalized. Independent complete enumeration of all 2x2 targets at q=2,3,5 confirmed every predicted fiber.
residual_risks: Computations are bounded corroboration; arbitrary-domain correctness follows from the mathematical block, wedge, orbit or EF proof, not finite tests.
